description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit pesticide and chemical application records with the applicator, crop plan and harvest records they answer to: the crop plan with its reference and the products it lists; each applicator record with its id, reference, name, license number and the moment the license expires; each application record with its id, reference, field, crop, product, rate and rate unit, the applicator, the moment applied and the pre-harvest interval in days it states; each harvest record with its id, reference, field, crop and the moment harvested. The signed report gives the applications and the applicators, each application against an applicator record holding a license in force on the day applied, each product applied against the products the crop plan lists, each harvest on an application’s field against the pre-harvest interval the application states, and each application against the field, rate and product its record needs, and counts them, and names divergent pesticide application records: an application with no applicator or license record behind it, a product applied that the crop plan does not list, a harvest record dated inside the pre-harvest interval the application record states, and an application missing the field, rate or product the record format requires; then an application stating no pre-harvest interval ahead of a harvest on its field and an application with no date beside a harvest on its field, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No applications, applicators named with no applicator records beside them, or no plan products beside applied products leaves those points unverified. Fields and records match by letters and digits, an applicator matches by reference or name, products match by name without case or punctuation, a license expires after the day it states, and a harvest on the same field and crop falls inside the interval when fewer days than the application states have passed since the day applied. This reads whether every spray was made by a licensed applicator with a planned product and kept clear of the harvest. Verdict agri_pesticide_divergent, agri_pesticide_partial, agri_pesticide_unverified or agri_pesticide_consistent. POST /api/agri-pesticide-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
